P.name: Organic Deconstruction
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Vel'Koz's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Deconstruction'' to enemies hit for 7 seconds, refreshing on {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
P.description2: The third stack consumes them all to deal {{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pp|35 + (180-35)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|true damage}}}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}.

Q.name: Plasma Fission
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Vel'Koz''' fires a plasma bolt in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 70% decaying over a duration.

''Plasma Fission'' can be recast after {{fd|0.25}} seconds while the bolt is in flight, and does so automatically upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow Duration|{{ap|1 to 2.6}} seconds}}
Q.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vel'Koz''' splits the bolt in two {{tt|over {{fd|0.25}} seconds|Estimated}}, each part firing perpendicularly in opposite directions and applying the same effects to enemies hit.
Q.description3: Whenever ''Plasma Fission'' kills an enemy, '''Vel'Koz''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|mana}}}}.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Mana Restored per Kill|{{as|{{ap|20 to 30}}|mana}}|Maximum Mana Restored|{{as|{{ap|20*3 to 30*3}}|mana}}}}

W.name: Void Rift
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vel'Koz''' cracks a rift in the target direction that opens after a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, cascading through the area over {{fd|0.65}} seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within.
W.description2: After {{tt|{{fd|0.75}} seconds|Estimated}}, the rift violently collapses, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and granting {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding area for {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
W.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|45 to 165}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|30+45 to 110+165}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}}}
W.description3: '''Vel'Koz''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Void Rift'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.

E.name: Tectonic Disruption
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vel'Koz''' hurls a disruptive anomaly that lands to the target location after {{pp|0.25;0.25 to 0.55|0;150 to 800 by 50|type=cast distance|formula=0.25 until 150 cast distance; 0.25 + 0.3 * (cast distance - 150) / 650 until maximum cast distance}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area briefly.
E.description2: If ''Tectonic Disruption'' is cast in close proximity of '''Vel'Koz''', the anomaly will also slightly {{tip|airborne|knock back}} enemies hit in the direction of the cast.

R.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
R.description: {{sbc|Passive - Researched:}} Applying 3 {{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|''Deconstruction''}} stacks to an enemy {{tip|champion}} marks them as ''Researched'' for 7 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and ability hits against them.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{fd|0.2}}-second delay, '''Vel'Koz''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.6}} seconds to project an energy beam, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. ''Life Form Disintegration Ray'' can be recast after 1 second during the channel, and does so automatically after the duration.
R.description3: The beam deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit every {{fd|0.2}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 20%, lingering for 1 second. ''{{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|Deconstruction}}'' is applied every {{fd|0.7}} seconds to enemies hit. {{ai|Researched|Vel'Koz|''Researched''}} enemies take {{as|true damage}} instead.
